messages:
maya: FYI CVE-2026-XXXX affecting OpenSSL in alpine: musl builds show crash in TLS renegotiation. Ubuntu packages also showing glibc symbol conflict. Need rebuild plan + signing/audit for private images.

sam: ack. priority: rebuild alpine:3.18-slim and ubuntu:22.04 baseimages with patched libssl/libcrypto, produce multi-arch (amd64/arm64) images. Basic steps:
- bump openssl -> 3.1.8
- run full integration tests
- sign images with cosign

sam: quick command for cosign with GCP KMS:
```
COSIGN_EXPERIMENT=1 cosign sign --key gcpkms://projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/infra/cryptoKeys/cosign-key gcr.io/redwood-inference/base:alpine-3.18-patch
```

olga: who has permission to use that KMS key? we need RBAC for the 'image-builder' service account and for oncall to push canary tags. propose role: roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter to builders; audit-only for others.

jen: also need to ensure image attestation stored in repo: tlog and in-house audit log. cosign public key rotation plan? create rotation window and store old keys in key history.

lee: can we do canary rollout to a slice of Dedicated before hosted? timeline: canary -> 4h smoke -> ramp 25% -> 24h monitor -> full. Rollback policy: if error-rate > 1% or latency p90 regresses > 50ms -> automatic rollback.

sam: test matrix: unit tests, e2e inference, KV cache correctness, cross-quantization sanity. Watch for musl vs glibc differences (thread stacks, symbols). If a regression, tag as 'rebuild/regress' and hold promotion.

ci-bot: build pipeline started for base:alpine-3.18-patch (amd64, arm64).

ci-bot: build succeeded: 2165432310

deploy-bot: scheduled canary deploy to 'dedicated-canary' 2165432500

maya: +1. olga please add 'image-builder@redwood' to KMS key policy, jen please coordinate tlog ingest. i'll draft a short runbook for oncall that includes how to verify cosign signatures and how to rollback images.

olga: on it. I'll also add an audit log alert for any cosign sign events outside the build pipeline: slack @sec-oncall if not CI SA.

jen: runbook checklist draft:
```
1) verify image signature: cosign verify --key gcpkms://... gcr.io/...
2) check tlog entry
3) run smoke inference test using --image
4) rollback: redeploy previous tag and invalidate canary in the console
```

lee: devex item: add a console endpoint to see image signature + KMS key id in UI for promoted images.

maya: timeline request: want canary today EOD if no blockers. if security signs off, we'll promote tomorrow morning.

sam: I'll watch the build. ping me if QA sees perf diff > 30ms.

maya: thanks all :thumbsup:
